comments.author: @jamesdeagle
comments.text: What happens if you break the speed limit driving a car? There is a ticket, fine, loss of insurance points or even loss of a driver`s licence. That is the reality of the real world. It is not fun but it is a needed reality and everybody knows it is needed or speeding is going to cause accidents. It is extremely hard for teachers to invoke consequences today. We are all in a bind. Will the next generation be able to hold a job? James

comments.author: @EmilyKresl
comments.text: Personally I have been saying for years that the classrooms are way too big for just one teacher to handle (have you ever tried watching 20-35 kids for 8 hours?) and I know teachers have been quiet quitting for decades the only difference now is that we can all watch videos of their crash outs talking about how stressed they are. It also probably doesn't help that teachers don't have unions anymore to help them fight for their rights to compromise on changes in the system.

comments.text:
In a 100 minute block, It's a good day if I can get 10 minutes of class focus/100 minues.
